notes.title: Version 0.5 released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43951233/aeea2ce6228dc3143c21cb6a01791d073b0bba9d.png[/img]

Now you can buy and improve a war drone. At level 1 he will only shoot and provide simple medical kits, at level 2 he will become stronger, faster and will provide better medical kits and at level 3 he will even drop friendly bombs that only explode in contact with the dead.

notes.title: Improved lightning boss gameplay and increased helicopter ammo damage.

notes.title: Version 0.4! New zombie and new boss!
notes.content:
Added a new zombie that carries a bomb in its belly and explodes when hit and added a new Boss that attracts lightning during the game.
The programming of game achievements has also started.
